title: os generate: generated metadata uses a different authoring style from the scaffold and docs, and four generators trap newcomers
body:
qa#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AecbS6JEeLdRWSW4AC

Filing gate: ③ a task on the maintainer's word. Asked in session on 2026-11-10, after the full-platform test run listed its improvement suggestions, verbatim: 「立卡处理」.

QA-source: #32135 · new-user flow (create-objectstack 18.3.0) · observed beside the clauses
Batch-of: objectstack-ai/objectstack#32135 follow-ups, 15 cards filed on the maintainer's 「立卡处理」

## What we saw

Measured with `@objectstack/cli` 18.3.0 in a fresh scaffold:
- `os g object ticket` writes a raw `{ type: 'text', … }` field, a default export and no `fieldGroups`; the scaffold's `note.object.ts` uses `Field.text(…)`, a named export and `fieldGroups`; the getting-started docs say field types are `Field.*` builders, "not raw strings".
- `os g view open_tickets` is refused because the name is read as the object name; there is no way to name a view separately.
- `os g action resolve --object ticket` is refused until a flow exists ("an action runs a flow"); the docs' tutorial action is a declarative `update`.
- `os g dashboard overview` writes a dashboard with `widgets: []` that is not added to any app's navigation; opened by URL it renders a blank page with only "Refresh All".
- `os --help` lists topics with one subcommand's description (`data  Create a new record`, `meta  Delete a metadata item`, `db  Reclaim SQLite free space…`).
- After adding a `description` field the validator warns it is `inert` ("nothing displays or reads it"), while the default create form and the record page's "More details" both show it.

## Proposed change

- Make every generator emit the scaffold's style (`Field.*`, named export, field groups).
- `os g view` takes `--object` plus its own name; `os g action` defaults to a declarative update action when no flow exists.
- `os g dashboard` adds a nav entry to the app (or prints the line to add) and the empty dashboard shows an empty state.
- Topic descriptions in `--help` describe the topic.
- Align `field-no-consumers` with what the default layouts actually draw, or say in the warning that the default form is not counted.

## Business reason

Who: new users and the coding agents that follow the CLI's output. Scenario: the first ten minutes of building. Cost: the agent learns two dialects and copies whichever it saw last; a newcomer meets refusals and a blank page on the documented path.

## Reader

Triage first touch; lands in `packages/cli` (generate, help topics) and the lint rule `field-no-consumers`.

## Duplicate check

`is:issue repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack generate object Field builder raw type` (216, open and closed); #22161 and #21370 (closed) are about the warning's length and the starter's latent warning, not this.
